transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I, um... well, I guess I'm here because... even when I'm feeling a bit better, I just... I can't shake this feeling. It's... it's about some people at my church, and... and in my walking club. I just feel like they're watching me. And... I think they're putting little messages about me in the church bulletin. Or... or just in the things they say when I'm around.
Have you been feeling deeply depressed most of the day?
I don't... I wouldn't use that word. No. I just... I don't think so.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high or euphoric?
No. I've never felt like that. Just... normal, I guess. Nothing like what you're saying.
Do you ever hear voices when no one else is there?

I... well, sometimes. Just... if the house is really quiet. I might hear my name, or... just a few words. It sounds like my friend, coming from the kitchen or out on the porch. It's... it's clear enough that I'll answer back before I realize I'm alone.
Have these experiences made it hard for you to keep up with your usual work or daily activities?

Well... I suppose things have changed a little. I still live at home, but... I don't really go to my quilting group anymore. Or the walking club. And the garden... I just haven't been out there much lately. My daughter comes by more now to make sure I'm eating and getting to my appointments. I guess... I just haven't felt up to doing much.
Have you found yourself caring much less than usual about things you used to enjoy?

I suppose so. I used to... I used to love being out in the garden. And quilting. Reading before bed, too. But lately... the quilt basket just sits there. And the weeds in the garden... I just let them grow. I don't really care much anymore.
When you hear the voice or feel that people are sending messages about you, are you also feeling depressed at those times?

I... yes, I think so. When things were really bad... when I wasn't eating much, and I just felt like I'd let everyone down... that's when I heard her voice the most. And... that's when I felt like the people from church were trying to send me messages. It all just seemed to happen at the same time.
Have there been times when you heard the voice or felt people were sending you messages even when you were not feeling depressed?

Yes, I suppose there was. A few weeks ago, I guess... I was feeling a bit lighter. I was getting dressed in the mornings, eating a little better. But... I still heard my name being called when I was alone in the house. And... I still thought the people at church were making those hints about me. So, yes, it still happened even when I wasn't feeling quite so heavy.
Have there been 2 weeks or more when you were not feeling depressed at all, but you still heard your name being called or believed people at church were sending you messages?

Yes... I suppose it was a spell of several weeks. Like I mentioned... I was getting dressed, eating a bit better. I didn't feel quite so weighed down for that stretch of time. But... yes. I still heard my name in the house. And I still thought people at church were hinting about me.
Have you had a period of at least 2 weeks when you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yes... much longer than two weeks, really. I suppose... the deep sadness, and the guilt... just that loss of interest in everything... it's been with me for about a year and two months now.
For at least one month, were the voices or the feeling that people were sending you messages present most days?

Yes... I suppose so. It's been... well, the voices and the messages... and just having a hard time keeping my thoughts straight... it's been going on for about eleven months now, I think. Most days, yes.
